entries.invariant: Every value-moving DEX intent accepted by the production shell must carry a nonce and advance the nonce table exactly once.
entries.residual_limits: Legacy replay fixtures may construct non-production configs. Deployment profile validation rejects nonce-free production/testnet postures.

entries.invariant: Accepted settlements are replayed from supplied intents and pre-state, then compared to canonical deltas and events before application.
entries.residual_limits: The guarantee applies to paths using the strong replay validator. Direct legacy conservation-only validation remains a test/backcompat posture.

entries.invariant: Parsed DEX intents must satisfy the normal-form field rules for their kind before settlement validation or signature-bound proof construction relies on them.
entries.residual_limits: The parser still returns the base Intent object. The normal-form gate is the current enforcement boundary.

entries.invariant: Local, public-testnet, and production-strict DEX engine profiles must fail closed on unsafe boundary switches before node/bootstrap admission.
entries.residual_limits: The profile helpers must be called by bootstrap/node code. The checker validates the named postures and is wired into the public-testnet candidate gate.

entries.invariant: For the current UPBA bounded price-grid surface, accepted certificates must bind the admitted intent set, pool state, fills, uniform price, and complete price-grid evidence.
entries.residual_limits: Current optimality evidence is scoped to bounded fixed-admission surfaces. Exact-out, multi-hop, inclusion fairness, and adaptive-grid sufficiency remain open work.

entries.invariant: A public-testnet candidate run must rebuild matching feature-suite, watcher, status-root, bundle, dual-operator, and live-intake evidence from the local checkout.
entries.residual_limits: This is same-machine replay and local public-network smoke evidence. A fresh two-machine Machine A/B run remains a separate operator test.

entries.invariant: RISC0 proof metadata must bind nonzero conflict-schedule, feature-suite, dependency-lock, guest, image, receipt, and checkpoint roots before ledger admission.
entries.residual_limits: This is metadata binding. Full proof-of-execution still needs broader guest coverage, pinned program IDs, reproducible inputs, and verifier registry policy.

entries.invariant: TEE proof metadata must bind quote and policy roots before ledger admission when a TEE attestation path is used.
entries.residual_limits: TEE metadata checks are narrower than full quote verification and enclave supply-chain policy.

entries.invariant: Protected swaps and critical settlements that require oracle authorization must reject missing, stale, wrong-profile, or mismatched authorization bundles.
entries.residual_limits: Authorization checks depend on profile-specific caller configuration. Production-strict deployment profile requires the DEX-side oracle authorization flags.

entries.invariant: Proof-mining claimability must be policy-gated by manager/runtime checks before public status and claim flows accept a claim.
entries.residual_limits: Mechanism-design refinements and external economic audits remain separate from the current claimability gate.
